class.name: HTMLDataTransfer
class.brief_description: String data exposed to clipboard and drag events.
class.description: Clipboard events currently expose [code]text/plain[/code]. HTML selection drags also expose sanitized [code]text/html[/code]. Drag payloads can use additional MIME types. Clipboard paste data is read-only; drag data is writable during [code]dragstart[/code], read-only during enter/over/drop, and protected during drag and dragend.

method.name: get_data
method.description: Returns the value associated with [param type], or an empty string when the type is absent or data is protected.

method.name: set_data
method.description: Sets a MIME payload while the transfer is writable. The type is normalized to lowercase.

method.name: clear_data
method.description: Clears one MIME payload, or all payloads when [param type] is empty. Protected and read-only transfers cannot be changed.

method.name: get_types
method.description: Returns the supported data types currently present.
